facts.text: I have been trying to improve my sleep habits.
I was wondering if calming essential oils could help me relax before bed.
I already use chamomile tea before bed.
I struggle to wake up at 7:00 AM.
It takes me around 30-45 minutes to get out of bed.
I have been trying to establish a consistent bedtime routine for the past two months.
I have a calming cup of herbal tea before sleep.
My herbal tea is usually peppermint or chamomile.
I read a book for at least 20 minutes before lights out.
Reading has helped me reduce my screen time.
I am considering using essential oils in addition to my herbal tea to enhance my relaxation.
I am thinking of trying the "Sleepy Time" essential oil blend.
I want to start with a smaller amount of essential oils, like 5-7 drops, and adjust to my liking.
I plan to use a diffuser with the "Sleepy Time" blend.
I have heard that diffusing essential oils can create a relaxing atmosphere.
I am excited to see how diffusing the "Sleepy Time" blend affects my sleep.
